tier.description: Evidence tier and subtype, e.g. T5_OFFICIAL or T1_HYPOTHESIS.

sourceType.description: Stable source class such as official_api, primary_text, lecture, training_derived, or reference_implementation.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical public URL when available. Null is allowed for local user-provided or implementation-derived artifacts.

quoteShort.description: Short supporting quote only when copyright policy permits it.

humanInterpretation.description: Human-authored summary of how the source supports this fixture or rule.

copyrightNote.description: Usage limits and copyright handling note.

authorityTruthEligible.description: True only when this record may be used in pass/fail authority accuracy denominators.
